question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
-- Final query with tier labels and rounded values
WITH italian_dec2021 AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id, (p.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST) AS profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52770
      AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
),
customer_profits AS (
    SELECT cust_id, SUM(profit) AS total_profit
    FROM italian_dec2021
    GROUP BY cust_id
),
customer_with_tiers AS (
    SELECT cust_id, total_profit,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS tier
    FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT 
    'Tier ' || tier AS tier_label,
    ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit,
    ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS highest_profit
FROM customer_with_tiers
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier
